root.name: アルセロール・ミタル

rows.ja: 製鉄所・発電資産の取得元

relations.text: Calvert製鉄所の日本製鉄持分50%を取得

source.label: ArcelorMittal 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: the Company confirmed that it had completed the acquisition of NSC's 50% equity stake in AMNS Calvert, with ArcelorMittal already holding the balance.

relations.text: 中国の自動車鋼板合弁VAMAの相手
relations.text_en: Partner in VAMA, its automotive steel JV in China

source.label: ArcelorMittal 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: and China through Valin ArcelorMittal Automotive Steel Co., Ltd ("VAMA"), a joint venture with Hunan Valin.

relations.text: 傭船の合弁Global Charteringの相手
relations.text_en: Partner in Global Chartering, its shipping JV

source.label: ArcelorMittal 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: AM Shipping also acts as the coordinator for Global Chartering Ltd., the Company's joint venture with DryLog Ltd., a Monaco based shipping company.

relations.text: 2014年に日本製鉄と共同でCalvert製鉄所を15.5億ドルで買収した相手
relations.text_en: Sold the Calvert plant to ArcelorMittal and NSC in 2014 for $1.55 billion

source.label: ArcelorMittal 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: The facility, subsequently renamed ArcelorMittal Calvert, was originally acquired by ArcelorMittal and NSC in 2014 from ThyssenKrupp for total consideration of $1.55 billion.

companies.name: アトラス・リニューアブル・エナジー

relations.text: ブラジルの太陽光発電合弁の残り50%を取得(2025年12月)
relations.text_en: Bought the remaining 50% of their Brazilian solar JV (Dec 2025)

source.label: ArcelorMittal 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: On December 12, 2025, ArcelorMittal acquired the remaining 50 % interest in the 50/50 joint venture with Atlas Renewable Energy ("Atlas") to operate a 265MW capacity solar energy project in Minas Gerais, Brazil.
